shared_elements: large bird in profile with rendered wing
band of repeated short parallel strokes / hatched register
vertically stacked registers on an upright pillar-shaped surface
striped or hatched infill used for wings and bodies
justification: Both surfaces are tall upright pillars carrying superimposed registers in which a prominent bird with a hatched, striped wing is the dominant creature, accompanied by serpentine forms, small quadrupeds and a horizontal band of repeated parallel strokes. The differences lie in the specifics: A has a rigid symmetrical scheme (single frontal-standing bird over crossed intertwined snakes over a mirrored pair of confronted birds), while B distributes its animals more loosely and irregularly beneath a row of three large heavy heads that has no counterpart in A.
